sentence: This project develops a way to measure the mutations that make cancer cells resist targeted therapies.
This project develops software for simulating rare events in biology, including how drugs cross a membrane and how viral infections work.
This project supports laboratory research on the molecular aspects of diabetes.
This project develops a simple test that uses CRISPR to detect microRNA in exosomes, aiming to find breast cancer early.
This project builds a microscope that images cancer cells spreading through a whole zebrafish, down to the level of single cells.
This project studies how breast cancer and its treatment affect thinking over time, and looks for shared causes of cancer and Alzheimer's disease.
This project studies whether cancer patients are more likely to have bad reactions to immunotherapy drugs, and which social factors are involved.
This project studies how much rehabilitation people receive after a stroke during the first year, and how it affects their recovery.
This project develops ultrasound imaging markers to detect and understand pain in the muscle and tissue of the heel.
This project develops a deep learning method that makes clear photon-counting CT images of arms and legs from less scan data.
This project tries to find out why yeast cells live for different lengths of time when their genes and surroundings are the same.
This project improves imaging probes that see inside the body with light, so that tissues are easier to tell apart in the images.
This project studies patients with lasting symptoms after Long Covid or Lyme disease to test whether an autoimmune attack damages their nerves.
This project tries to find out why oral immunotherapy for food allergy causes gastrointestinal side effects, by studying immune responses in blood and esophagus.
This project applies artificial intelligence and data science to health problems in Hawaii and the Pacific Islands.
This project tests whether proteins can pass traits from parents to offspring in mammals.
This project builds protein tags that let scientists watch viral proteins being made and put together inside living cells.
This project aims to understand digestive diseases and to develop treatments for them.
This project studies how changes in fat metabolism affect T cells that stop fighting tumors.
This project studies how helper T cells that make Interleukin-21 form in lymph nodes near tumors and what helps them grow during immunotherapy.
